test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four numbers have been given, out of which one is different from the other three in some manner. Select the number that is different from the rest.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Only 729 is a perfect cube among all of the options.**

⇒ 743 = (743)¹/³ = 9.057

⇒ 716 = (716)1/3 = 8.946

⇒ **729** = (729)1/3 = **9**

⇒ 741 = (741)1/3 = 9.049

Hence, **option 3)** is different from the rest.
